diagnostics: Selected moving-average by minimum rolling-origin WAPE, then MAE.
Calibrated the interval radius from 168 held-out errors.
All candidate exclusions and fold-level predictions remain serialized for audit.
limitations: Backtest performance does not establish causal effects or future policy impact.
Intervals are split-conformal-style empirical residual bands over the declared folds; they do not guarantee coverage under distribution shift.
Baseline methods omit exogenous variables, structural breaks, and operational feedback.
